title: Switchboard / Origins
description: Origin fleet health built for hundreds of backends: what needs attention now, a sortable scorecard for every origin, and top-N outliers.

list.name: instance
list.label: Instance
list.description: Switchboard process (service.instance.id). Each restart gets a new id.

list.name: topn
list.label: Top N
list.description: How many outliers the top-N panels show.

panels.title: Origins
panels.description: Origins reporting health in the selection.

panels.title: Unhealthy
panels.description: Failing active health checks on at least one instance.

panels.title: Ejected
panels.description: Removed from routing by passive health.

targets.expr: (count(max by (origin) (switchboard_origin_up{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}) == 1) or vector(0)) / count(max by (origin) (switchboard_origin_up{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}))

panels.title: Origins needing attention
panels.description: Only origins that are unhealthy, ejected, failing more than 5% of requests (5xx or transport errors), or failing any health checks right now. An empty table is the goal. Click an origin to drill in.

targets.expr: (min by (origin) (switchboard_origin_up{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"})) and on (origin) ((min by (origin) (switchboard_origin_up{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}) == 0) or (max by (origin) (switchboard_origin_ejected{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}) == 1) or ((sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_requests_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin", code=~"0|5.."}[5m])) / sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_requests_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[5m]))) > 0.05) or ((sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_health_checks_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin", result!="success"}[5m])) / sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_health_checks_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[5m]))) > 0))

(min by (origin) (switchboard_origin_uptime_ratio{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"})) and on (origin) ((min by (origin) (switchboard_origin_up{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}) == 0) or (max by (origin) (switchboard_origin_ejected{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}) == 1) or ((sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_requests_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin", code=~"0|5.."}[5m])) / sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_requests_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[5m]))) > 0.05) or ((sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_health_checks_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin", result!="success"}[5m])) / sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_health_checks_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[5m]))) > 0))

panels.title: All origins
panels.description: Every origin in the selection with its health, load, errors, and latency over the last 5 minutes. Sort by any column (click the header) and filter with the funnel icon; with hundreds of origins, sort by Error ratio, p95, or Queued to find outliers. Click an origin to drill in.

targets.expr: sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_requests_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin", code=~"0|5.."}[5m])) / sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_requests_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[5m]))

(sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_health_checks_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin", result!="success"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_health_checks_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[5m]))) / sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_health_checks_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[5m]))

sum by (origin) (increase(switchboard_origin_ejections_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[24h])) or 0 * max by (origin) (switchboard_origin_up{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"})

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Origins with the highest share of 5xx responses plus transport failures (code 0: refused, reset, or timed out).

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_requests_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin", code=~"0|5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_requests_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[$__rate_interval])))
topk($topn, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, origin) (rate(switchboard_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Queued requests (saturation)
panels.description: Requests waiting for a free slot on the origin (MaxParallelRequests). Sustained queues mean the origin is saturated.

panels.title: Health-check failure rate
panels.description: Share of active health probes failing.

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_health_checks_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin", result!="success"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (origin) (rate(switchboard_origin_health_checks_total{service_instance_id=~"$instance", origin=~"$origin"}[$__rate_interval])))
